title: Personal Credit Cards: Paying Account Behind the Autopay Kept on a Closed Card
content:
Where a Personal Credit Cards account closes owing money, whether its automatic payment carries on turns on the checking account the card names to pay it.

## Rule

The question is judged at the moment the closure is confirmed, from the automatic payment instruction then on the card and the bank's checking records.

- If the paying account the card names belongs to the cardholder, is a checking account held with PCB and stands active, the instruction kind in force at that moment is carried onto the closed card unchanged, whether it takes the minimum payment, the statement balance or a fixed sum.
- If the card names no paying account, or names one that is not active, or one the bank's checking records do not hold, the kind carried onto the closed card is none.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Paying account named on the card | Its status | Carried onto the closed card |
|---|---|---|
| cardholder's PCB checking | active | the instruction kind then in force |
| cardholder's PCB checking | restricted | none |
| none named | not applicable | none |

The instruction read is the one standing on the card when the confirmation takes effect.
